text:
We’ve reached that stage at AdBeets where our ideas don’t fit inside our current walls anymore

So here I am on a mission to find a workspace that feels like us

Not a hostel-converted box.
Not a maze where people disappear into dark passages.
Not a co-working space unless it has a proper private entry from the main entrance because privacy, identity, and team comfort matter to us.

I’m searching for a space that says:

“This is where a growing team builds big things.”

What we’re looking for : 

✨ A 40-seater floor that breathes
✨ Two cabins that hold big decisions
✨ One meeting room where ideas collide beautifully
✨ A pantry where conversations begin
✨ A clean facade with sunlight  because energy matters
✨ A layout that feels connected, not lost

If you’ve seen a place in Gachibowli / Financial District / Any Prime Location in Hyderabad that carries this kind of vibe…

OR 

If you know anyone who can help us with this requirement,

Send it my way.Sowmya Erothu
Please DM me or connect me with those who can help me out at sowmyasri@adbeets.com

We’re not just moving offices 
We’re choosing the next chapter of AdBeets.

And I’m honoured to lead that search. ✨
